review_method: Independent read-only prospective control review of the final plan and June-disposition bytes.

answers.basis: The loader revalidates the exact reviewed Exposed 002 plan, amendment, data binding, cost model, chronology, 60-parent grid, 120 discovery rows, gates, neighbors, and cohort rules. Only candidate and neighbor IDs are rekeyed.
Program, campaign, plan, candidate, reservation, run, attempt, database, runtime-root, and report identities are new; no Exposed 002 runtime row is imported.
The plan opts into research-attempts-v1 with a 300-second lease, 60-second heartbeat, three total infrastructure attempts, and retry only after an expired no-result infrastructure lease.
Committed Intraday V2 exposure metadata makes June ineligible. The disposition forbids June reads, a substitute range, a controlled plan, and controlled evaluation regardless of cohort size.
The exact Exposed 002 strategy and engine source SHA-256 values are frozen and revalidated. A proven defect requires a stop before strategy execution.
All qualification, controlled-evaluation, holdout, paper, broker-write, and live authorities are false. June, V3, PAPER, broker/live, and strategic-allocation-21 access remain forbidden.
No Intraday Exposed 001/002, V1/V2/V3, Rapid-002/003/004 runtime, report, result, plan, or evidence artifact is changed by this plan slice.

scope_limit: The review inspected committed metadata and source only. It did not open market data, strategy results, June or V3 data, or PAPER, broker, live, or strategic-allocation-21 state.
